purpose: 复核北方组织版本 1 的允许决策；完整归档还包含结论相反的后续版本 2。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive north.audit --org 'north factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 3 --fingerprint "$(cat north.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 复核南方组织同名主体、资源和策略的版本 1，观察其独立的历史拒绝结果。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive south.audit --org 'south factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 2 --fingerprint "$(cat south.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "matched deny policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes
